name: CoTracker3
plain: CoTracker3 (Meta AI, 2024): tracks any point through a video, all points jointly: a transformer refines the tracks with correlation features, attending over time and across tracks; offline (the whole video at once) and online (16-frame windows). Non-commercial: CC-BY-NC-4.0 code and weights.
summary: CoTracker3 (Karaev et al., Meta AI 2024): tracking any point with a transformer that tracks all points jointly. A CNN encodes every frame at 384 x 512 into 128-channel features at 1/4 resolution (a 4-level pyramid); each track correlates the 7 x 7 neighbourhood of its current position with the 7 x 7 support of its query on every level (an MLP encodes the 4D correlation), and a transformer with attention over time and, through 64 virtual tracks, across tracks updates positions, visibility and confidence in 6 iterations. Offline: the whole video at once; online: sliding windows of 16 frames, 8 new frames per step.

papers.title: CoTracker3: Simpler and Better Point Tracking by Pseudo-Labelling Real Videos

limitations: Frames are resized to 384 x 512 (the training size and that of upstream's predictor), whatever their size and aspect ratio.
cotracker3-offline holds the features of every frame (about 4 MB per frame in float16); cotracker3-online processes 16-frame windows and only keeps the tracks.
Visibility is upstream's score, rescaled so that 0.5 is upstream's threshold: the offline predictor's visibility > 0.9, the online predictor's visibility x confidence > 0.6.
One video per call; all queries of a call share the video.
cotracker3-online: the online window loop is data-dependent (6 graph breaks; `torch.export` guards on data), so no ONNX / TensorRT export; cotracker3-offline exports.
task_io: Input: a video (its frames in order) and query points `(t, x, y)`. Output: the position of every query in every frame and the probability that it is visible there.
